fallbackList.typescript: (_combined, state) => { const stableJson = (v) => { if (v === null || typeof v !== "object") return JSON.stringify(v); if (Array.isArray(v)) return "[" + v.map(stableJson).join(",") + "]"; return "{" + Object.keys(v).sort().map((k) => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + stableJson(v[k])).join(",") + "}"; }; const schema = state["Marking Schema"]; const subs = state["Student Submissions"]; const list = Array.isArray(subs) ? subs : subs ? [subs] : []; const text = (s) => (typeof s?.content === "string" ? s.content : typeof s?.body === "string" ? s.body : ""); const name = (s, i) => (typeof s?.filename === "string" && s.filename ? s.filename : typeof s?.doc_id === "string" ? s.doc_id : `student_${i + 1}.md`); return { marking_schema: { filename: "marking_schema.json", content: stableJson(schema ?? {}) }, student_submissions: list.map((s, i) => ({ filename: name(s, i), content: text(s) })) }; }

modules.label: Flatten Sections
modules.note: One gradable row per student × rubric question.
modules.inputDescription: GraderWork — marking_schema Document plus list of student submission Documents

fallbackList.typescript: (work) => { let sections = []; const ms = work.marking_schema; if (ms?.sections) sections = ms.sections; else if (typeof ms?.content === "string") { try { sections = JSON.parse(ms.content).sections ?? []; } catch {} } const out = []; for (const sub of work.student_submissions ?? []) { const content = sub.content ?? ""; const student = (content.match(/Student:\s*([^\n]+)/i) || [])[1]?.trim() || sub.filename?.replace(/\.md$/i, "") || "student"; for (const sec of sections) { for (const q of sec.questions ?? []) { const qRe = new RegExp(`\\*\\*${q.question_id}\\.\\*\\*[\\s\\S]*?(Student work:[^\\n]*)`, "i"); const workLine = (content.match(qRe) || [])[1]?.trim() ?? ""; out.push({ student_label: student, section_id: sec.section_id, title: `${sec.title} — ${q.question_id}`, body: `${q.prompt ?? ""}${workLine ? "\n" + workLine : ""}`, max_score: q.max_score ?? 1, criteria: q.marking_criteria ?? sec.criteria ?? "" }); } } } return out; }

modules.label: Grade Each Section
modules.inputDescription: List of GradableSection objects — student_label, question body, max_score, and criteria
modules.prompt: Apply criteria literally and deterministically. When criteria lists alternate bands (e.g. 'award exactly N pts if…'), check those bands before summing components — pick exactly one band score, never mix. Score MUST equal the exact points from the matching band or component sum — use only point values explicitly named in criteria (no rounding, no extra credit, no in-between scores). Score is an integer from 0 to max_score inclusive. Copy max_score from input unchanged. Set correct=true iff score equals max_score; never set correct=true when score is below max_score. Copy student_label and section_id exactly from input. When correct is false, mistake_explanation must cite the rubric clause applied and state the student's wrong value vs the required value. When correct is true, mistake_explanation must be an empty string.

modules.label: Final Output
modules.inputDescription: List of SectionGrade rows — student_label, section_id, score, max_score, correct, mistake_explanation (one row per student × rubric question)

modules.label: Grade Count Check
modules.note: len(Student Submissions) × len(Marking Questions List) = len(Final Output)
modules.inputDescription: List of SectionGrade rows — student_label, section_id, score, max_score, correct, mistake_explanation (one row per student × rubric question)

fallbackList.python:
n_students = len_of(step('Student Submissions'))
n_questions = len_of(step('Marking Questions List'))
n_out = len_of(step('Final Output'))
if n_students * n_questions != n_out:
    raise ValueError(f'expected {n_students}×{n_questions}={n_students * n_questions} grades, got {n_out}')
